name: Faculty
source:
[b]Nowadays. Small European city.

Your friends are in danger.[/b]

This is a story about students of the Faculty of Mystic Studies who are faced with a series of mysterious circumstances. 

Rumors about the Brotherhood of the Enlightened are increasingly heard in the city. 

Find out what this organization does: helps those in need or conducts forbidden rituals.

[b]Who can you trust? Who is behind all this? What secrets does the cult really hide?

Find answers to all these questions[/b]

[From [url=https://zylyx.itch.io/faculty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]如今。欧洲小城市。

你的朋友正处于危险之中。[/b]

这是关于神秘学院的学生们面临一系列神秘事件的故事。

关于启蒙者兄弟会的谣言在城里越来越多。

了解该组织的业务：帮助有需要的人或进行禁止的仪式。

[b]你可以信任谁？这一切的幕后黑手是谁？该邪教到底隐藏着什么秘密？

找到所有这些问题的答案[/b]

[来自[url=https://zylyx.itch.io/faculty]Itch.io[/url]]
